caption:
Everyone sees your weakness before they see you. You brace to be turned away — but what if the ones who matter run toward you instead? (Galatians 4:12-16 devotional)

In a world that read sickness as heaven's curse, the Galatians received the frail, ailing Paul "as an angel of God" — the gospel's nerve to leap a wall everyone else honored. Your worth wasn't fixed in the clinic but at the cross, where Christ became a curse for you and took the verdict. So weakness can no longer name you, and no rejection gets the last word.

📌 Save this for when weakness makes you brace for rejection
